nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You're awake?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: …Sorry, who are you?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Q. I sit next to you. You really don't remember?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Right. You've only just woken up.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Biology's next. It'll start in a minute.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: What time is it?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Nearly nine. Second bell's due any minute.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Biology first.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You say nothing.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: All right. Still waking up, then.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Biology's next, by the way.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Biology?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Yeah. You hate biology, don't you? Last term's exam—did you miss it altogether, or hand in a blank paper? I can't remember which.

effects.speaker: q
effects.text: Q remembers something went wrong at last term's biology exam, but cannot say whether you missed the room or handed in a blank paper.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Do you remember?

choices.text: I handed in a blank paper?
I can't remember any of it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: I handed in a blank paper?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I think that's what you told me. Or I might be mixing the two up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: I never made it into the exam room?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I think you never made it into the exam room. I don't know what happened after that. You never mentioned it again.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: I can't remember any of it.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Right. You barely opened the textbook around then, either.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Anyway. Biology again today.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: She might ask questions today. Have you memorised the key points?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Questions? About what?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Ecosystems.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: What's an ecosystem?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: It's everything living in one place, plus the place itself. What eats what, what grows where, where the water goes. That sort of thing.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Sounds like they've shoved a lot of things under one label.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: More or less. That should be enough to get you through a question.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You don't answer.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: All right. Maybe she won't ask today. She hasn't even come in yet.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You look for the textbook.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Looking for your book? I thought you always had it with you.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You should check your bag. You had it by your feet a minute ago.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: I need to find a pen, anyway.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Find it?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: My textbook's gone.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: How? I saw you put your bag here this morning.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Look again. It might be under the exercise books.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Did you take it?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Me? I can barely keep track of my own things.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: What would I want with your biology book? So I can study?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (Never mind.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: All right. I won't ask.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: If she asks, deal with it then. No need to confess to anything yet.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You heard her. That's practically a free period. Want to get some air? The yard?

choices.text: You go ahead. I'll sit here for a bit.
No. I think I'll stay here.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: All right. Let's go.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You decided to leave the classroom for the free period.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Come on, then. I'll wait by the door.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You go ahead. I'll sit here for a bit.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: All right. I won't rush you. Come out if you feel like it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: No. I think I'll stay here.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You chose to stay in the classroom for the free period.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: All right. I won't rush you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You say nothing and keep packing.)

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Fine. I'll take that as a no.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You haven't checked your bag yet? It's right by your foot.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Don't wait for the bell to find out you've left the book behind.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Second bell.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: B's not here. She'd usually be at the door by now.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Don't look at me. I don't know where she is either.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Stand up.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: I said stand.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Everyone else has the book open. You have your hands.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: Come here. Bring your bag.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The set square going down on the front desk. Hard. You remember the sound. You are less sure about anything else.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You half-remember the wooden set square being put down hard on the front desk, and you do not trust the memory.

nodes.speaker: b
nodes.text: You will see me about this.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Morning. Um… is everyone here?

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I'm covering biology today. The usual teacher isn't here. I wasn't told much more than that.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: The office gave me a register. I'll take attendance first.

effects.speaker: n
effects.text: N says they are covering biology because the usual teacher is absent.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: When I read your name, just say here.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: She read out a few names. Nobody answered. N checked the list, then looked up at the empty desks.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Is this really all of you?

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: They've all gone out to play.

nodes.speaker: student
nodes.text: Skipped class. Most of them, anyway.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: …Right.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Well. A couple of things, then.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Where's the usual teacher?

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Her name's crossed off the register. I don't know what happened, either.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Do we need the textbook?

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I suppose so. I don't know where the spare copies are kept, though.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: If someone knows, you can go and get one. I won't make a whole thing of it today.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (You wait.)

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: Nobody says anything. N looks down at the register, turns it over, then turns it back.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: All right. Let's not pretend we're going to have a proper lesson today.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: If you want to stay, read quietly. If you'd rather go to the yard for a while, that's fine too. Just don't go too far.

effects.speaker: n
effects.text: N says the class may study quietly or spend the period in the yard.

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: I'll be here. If you need something… come and ask.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You remembered me at last? I thought you were going to walk the whole way alone.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: (Q catches up and falls into step beside you.)
